mentions.name: Springdrift (Artificial Retainer runtime)
mentions.description: A runtime for a long-lived LLM agent ('Artificial Retainer') with ambient continuous self-perception, persistent memory, defined authority, domain-specific autonomy, and forensic accountability, designed to maintain a decades-long trusted, stable relationship with a human as a valuable colleague rather than a friend.
mentions.source_excerpt: A runtime for a long-lived LLM agent with ambient continuous self-perception, persistent memory, defined authority, domain-specific autonomy, and forensic accountability, all in a long ongoing relationship with a human. I call this type of system an Artificial Retainer, a non-human cross between a guide dog and someone like your accountant or lawyer.
